text: Planning a trip is always exciting, from choosing the destination to packing your bags. Once you arrive, immersing yourself in a new culture is the real reward. You might find yourself trying foods you’ve never heard of, like a spicy street snack or a sweet dessert from a local bakery. Of course, language barriers can be tricky; you might point at a menu or use hand gestures to order a meal. Despite the confusion, these moments often make the funniest memories. Years later, you’ll laugh about getting lost or mispronouncing a word, but the experience—and the delicious food—will stay with you forever.
